content_zh:
就在这时，四合院大门口传来一声惊呼：“陈阳，以晴，你们这么快就好上了？”
此时叶以晴半躺在陈阳的怀里，陈阳左手将她搂住，右手还放在她身上，而叶以晴则是环绕着陈阳的颈部，两人的动作看起来的确像是有不一般的关系。
听到门口的声音，叶以晴嗖的把环绕在陈阳颈后的手缩回来，推了陈阳一把，往后退开数步，瞪眼指着陈阳：“小偷，和我保持距离，不然要你好看。”
陈阳慵懒地笑了笑，无辜地抬起摸了叶以晴的右手：“不好意思，我不是故意的。”
叶以晴哪里相信他的话，上下打量着看起来有些瘦弱的陈阳，秀眉微蹙，心头暗暗想道：“刚才他转身时，那一瞬间的冰冷感，难道是我的错觉？”
没有多想，叶以晴看向了四合院的门口，那里站着一个身穿旗袍的女人。
不得不说，这个女人长得非常美，五官精致得仿佛画卷里雕琢的一般，皮肤白里透红，找不到任何瑕疵，一双丹凤眼里似乎有说不尽的故事，一头民`国时期流行的短发，更是增添了复古的韵味。
而她的身躯在旗袍的包裹下，勾勒出S型的身材，她的三围都不突出，可是融合在一起，却是那么的完美。
“子宁姐，终于见到你了，好想你呀！”
在叶以晴一脸惊诧的目光中，陈阳走过去，给了苏子宁一个大大的拥抱，然后朝着苏子宁的额头上吻了下去。
就在即将触碰的刹那，一只柔软的手掌挡住了陈阳的嘴唇，苏子宁爱怜地看着陈阳，微笑道：“都二十岁的人了，怎么还跟小时候一样。”
“嘻嘻，十多年没见你，一时没忍住。”陈阳笑着挠了挠脑袋，像是个天真的孩子。
如果那些杀人不眨眼的家伙看到陈阳这般模样，只怕世界观都会被颠覆，而陈阳也只有在面对苏子宁时，他才会露出这样的神态。
事实上，苏子宁是陈家的仆人，比陈阳大了九岁，陈阳小的时候住在四合院，她一直照顾陈阳，对陈阳非常好，说是仆人，但她和陈阳却情同姐弟，感情十分深厚。
“果然还是子宁姐漂亮，这些年我见过穿旗袍的女人那么多，却没有一个比你有味道。”陈阳上下打量着苏子宁，啧啧赞道。
“没个正形。”苏子宁轻轻敲了下陈阳的额头，正想说什么，旁边的叶以晴已经看不下去，打断道：“等等，子宁姐，你能不能告诉我到底怎么回事，为什么我们家会突然出现一个男人？”
陈阳学着叶以晴的口气道：“对呀，子宁姐，我想知道，为什么我的房子会出现这个我不认识的女人，而且刚才我洗澡的时候，她突然闯进来说要给我按摩，让我舒服。她身上穿着警服，其实是个女流氓。”
“你说谁是女流氓，信不信我扁你！”叶以晴张牙舞爪地喊道，却没有再叫陈阳小偷，因为她已经看出来，陈阳还真不是私闯民宅。
在苏子宁的印象里，叶以晴的身手非常了得，她生怕叶以晴出手伤了陈阳，忙劝道：“以晴，你们都误会了，我给你介绍一下，这是陈老的孙子陈阳，陈老去世之后，这座四合院就由他继承，从此以后，他就是你的房东了。”
什么，房东！

叶以晴面露苦色，她本以为陈阳是苏子宁的远房亲戚什么的，却没料到竟然会是这座四合院的主人，自己的房东。
苏子宁又对陈阳介绍道：“陈阳，这是叶以晴警官，她现在住在东院的第二间房，是咱们这里的房客。”
陈阳早知道对方是房客，但他却感到疑惑，为何四合院会租出去，爷爷可不会缺这么点租金。
“既然你是房东，那今天我就原谅你了，你们慢慢聊。”
知道陈阳是房东，叶以晴自觉有些理亏，想到自己刚才推开浴室门看了陈阳的身体，还说了那番耍流氓的话，她更是羞得双颊通红，恨不得找个地缝钻进去，转身就朝自己的房间走去。
看着叶以晴快步走开的背影，陈阳笑了笑，并没有揪住不放，他可不想把这么漂亮的房客给赶走，那就得不偿失了。
“你还敢笑，叶警官可是跆拳道黑带，如果惹急了她，你铁定被他揍。不过你别看她凶巴巴的样子，她这人外刚内柔。”苏子宁简单说了下叶以晴的情况，随即脸上露出关怀之色道：“陈阳，这十多年你去了哪里，过得怎么样？”

At this moment, an exclamation came from the gate of the courtyard: "Chen Yang, Yi Qing, are you getting better so soon?"
At this time, Ye Yiqing was half lying in Chen Yang's arms. Chen Yang held her with his left hand and his right hand was still on her body. Ye Yiqing was wrapped around Chen Yang's neck. The two people's movements did seem to have an unusual relationship.
Hearing the sound at the door, Ye Yiqing retracted the hand that was wrapped around Chen Yang's neck, pushed Chen Yang, stepped back a few steps, and pointed at Chen Yang with a glare: "Thief, keep your distance from me, or I'll make you look good."
Chen Yang smiled lazily, innocently raised his right hand and touched Ye Yiqing's right hand: "I'm sorry, I didn't mean it."
How could Ye Yiqing believe what he said? She looked up and down at Chen Yang, who looked a little thin, and frowned slightly, thinking to herself: "When he turned around just now, the cold feeling in that moment was my imagination?"
Without thinking much, Ye Yiqing looked at the door of the courtyard, where a woman wearing a cheongsam stood.
It has to be said that this woman is very beautiful, her facial features are as delicate as if they were carved in a painting, her skin is white and rosy, and there are no flaws. Her eyes seem to have endless stories, and her short hair, which was popular during the Republic of China, adds to the retro charm.
And her body, wrapped in a cheongsam, outlines an S-shaped figure. Her measurements are not prominent, but they blend together so perfectly.
"Sister Zining, I finally see you, I miss you so much!"
Under Ye Yiqing's surprised look, Chen Yang walked over, gave Su Zining a big hug, and then kissed Su Zining on the forehead.
Just when they were about to touch, a soft palm blocked Chen Yang's lips. Su Zining looked at Chen Yang lovingly and smiled: "You are already twenty years old, why are you still the same as when you were a child?"
"Hehe, I haven't seen you for more than ten years, so I couldn't hold it back for a while." Chen Yang smiled and scratched his head, like an innocent child.
If those murderous guys saw Chen Yang like this, their world view would be subverted, and Chen Yang would only show such an attitude when facing Su Zining.
In fact, Su Zining was a servant of the Chen family, nine years older than Chen Yang. Chen Yang lived in a courtyard when he was young. She had always taken care of Chen Yang and was very kind to Chen Yang. She said she was a servant, but she and Chen Yang were like siblings and had a very deep relationship.
"Sure enough, Sister Zining is still beautiful. I have seen so many women wearing cheongsam over the years, but none of them are as beautiful as you." Chen Yang looked up and down at Su Zining and praised her.
"It's not formal." Su Zining lightly tapped Chen Yang's forehead. Just as he was about to say something, Ye Yiqing beside him couldn't stand it any longer and interrupted: "Wait a minute, Sister Zining, can you tell me what's going on? Why did a man suddenly appear in our house?"
Chen Yang imitated Ye Yiqing's tone and said: "Yes, Sister Zining, I want to know why this woman I don't know appears in my house. And when I was taking a shower just now, she suddenly broke in and said she wanted to give me a massage to make me feel comfortable. She was wearing a police uniform, but she was actually a female gangster."
"Who are you calling a female hooligan? Believe it or not, I'll beat you up!" Ye Yiqing shouted with bared teeth, but she didn't call Chen Yang a thief again, because she had already seen that Chen Yang really wasn't breaking into a private house.
In Su Zining's impression, Ye Yiqing's skills were very good. She was afraid that Ye Yiqing would hurt Chen Yang, so she hurriedly advised: "Yi Qing, you have all misunderstood. Let me introduce to you. This is Mr. Chen's grandson Chen Yang. After Mr. Chen passed away, he will inherit this courtyard house. From now on, he will be your landlord."
What, the landlord!
Ye Yiqing had a bitter look on her face. She originally thought that Chen Yang was a distant relative of Su Zining, but she didn't expect that he would be the owner of this courtyard, her landlord.
Su Zining faced Chen Yang againHe introduced: "Chen Yang, this is Police Officer Ye Yiqing. She currently lives in the second room in the east courtyard and is our tenant here."
Chen Yang had known that the other party was a tenant, but he was confused as to why the courtyard was rented out. Grandpa would not be short of such a small amount of rent.
"Since you are the landlord, I will forgive you today. You can chat slowly."
Knowing that Chen Yang was the landlord, Ye Yiqing felt a little unjust. Thinking that she had just opened the bathroom door, looked at Chen Yang's body, and said those hooligan words, her cheeks turned red with embarrassment. She wanted to find a crack in the ground to crawl in, turned around and walked towards her room.
Looking at Ye Yiqing's back walking away quickly, Chen Yang smiled and did not hold on to her. He didn't want to drive away such a beautiful tenant, as it would be more of a loss than a gain.
